criterion: Prunes expired events outside [now - window_s, now] using the injected clock callable in ratelimiter/quota.py before evaluating admission.
Supports variable request cost in QuotaLimiter.check_and_consume(key, cost=1) and computes retry_after_s as the exact time until enough old cost expires when a request is rejected.
Ensures rejected requests do not record partial cost in the sliding window so subsequent smaller requests that fit within remaining capacity still succeed.
Adds unit tests under tests/ verifying sliding-window expiration, multi-unit cost rejection, accurate retry_after_s, and non-mutation on rejected requests.
All unit tests under tests/ pass via python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
